pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Dark patches exhibit sub-polygonal geometry with soft, non-linear pixel gradients at the edges. Relative spatial area of patches is larger on the flank and smaller/more concentrated along the upper neck.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Light-colored negative space forms a continuous lattice with clearly defined tri-radial junction nodes. Pixel thickness of the corridors remains narrow and relatively uniform across the visible torso.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane along the neck presents a low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette against the background, with visible individual hair-tip pixel clusters.
